dataset_name: International Cricket Master Player & Lineup Dataset (2025–2026)
null_policy: Explicit null (JSON) or empty string (CSV) when a field or sub-statistic is unavailable or unverified. Never guessed or fabricated.

selection_category_groups.D: Reserve, travelling reserve, and injury replacement players
selection_category_groups.E: Available in national selection pool but not recently selected
selection_category_groups.F: Retired or inactive historical players (not selectable)

files.countries/countries.json: Metadata for the 21 core men's international teams (12 Full Members + 9 Associate Members) plus expandable opponent entries.
files.players/all_players.json: Master biographical, role, debut, status, and selection metadata for all 597 unique international players.
files.players/all_players.csv: Flat CSV export of players/all_players.json with identical 27 columns.
files.players/player_format_statistics.json: Format-independent Test, ODI, and T20I career statistics (as of 2026-11-03) and separate 2025–2026 period tracking.
files.players/player_availability.json: Current national selection availability, active/retired status, and injury/unavailability notes for all 597 players.
files.squads/test_squads.json: Independent Test squads for all 12 Full Member nations with role breakdowns, captains, vice-captains, and reserves.
files.squads/odi_squads.json: Independent ODI squads for all 20 ODI-status nations (12 Full Members + 8 CWC League 2 Associates).
files.squads/t20i_squads.json: Independent T20I squads for all 21 core nations.
files.squads/selection_pools.json: 1,294 country-and-format selection pool records classifying every player across the 9 standardized selection categories.
files.matches/test_matches.json: 67 completed men's Test match records within 1 Jan 2025 – 3 Nov 2026.
files.matches/odi_matches.json: 244 completed men's ODI match records within 1 Jan 2025 – 3 Nov 2026.
files.matches/t20i_matches.json: 264 completed men's T20I match records within 1 Jan 2025 – 3 Nov 2026.
files.matches/test_lineups.json: 15 fully verified Test match lineup records (30 team Playing XIs in 1–11 batting order).
files.matches/odi_lineups.json: 20 fully verified ODI match lineup records (40 team Playing XIs in 1–11 batting order).
files.matches/t20i_lineups.json: 24 fully verified T20I match lineup records (48 team Playing XIs in 1–11 batting order).
files.captains/format_captains.json: 53 format-specific captain and vice-captain records across all 21 countries, including 2025–2026 transitions.
files.summaries/country_coverage.json: Per-country player, match, lineup, and selection pool counts across all 21 core nations.
files.summaries/format_coverage.json: Per-format aggregate counts for Test, ODI, and T20I.
files.summaries/missing_data_report.json: Explicit documentation of incomplete fields, <50 match countries/formats, and unresolved source conflicts.
